name: OAuth 2.0 & SSO Account Takeover Vulnerability Auditor
description: High-severity OAuth 2.0 and Single Sign-On (SSO) account takeover auditor for bug bounty hunters. Detects redirect_uri path traversal bypasses, open redirect chaining, missing state CSRF fixation, and unverified email pre-account takeovers.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_redirect_uri_traversal.description: Test redirect_uri parameter with directory traversal bypasses (/..;/, /%2e%2e/)

test_state_fixation.description: Check if state parameter is omitted, static, or unverified against active session

test_pre_account_takeover.description: Check if identity provider links unverified email accounts without password verification
